_metadata.title: Government Housing & Industrial Development Subsidies, Incentives & FAR Concessions
_metadata.portal_name: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) / State Town Planning Portals
_metadata.disclaimer: Statutory eligibility guidelines. Must be verified with local development authority prior to architectural submission.

incentives.title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY-U 2.0) Credit Linked Subsidy
incentives.authority: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
incentives.benefits: Interest subsidy up to ₹1.80 Lakh on home loans for eligible unit buyers, boosting project sales velocity.
incentives.eligibility: Annual household income <= ₹9.0 Lakhs; carpet area <= 60 sqm.
incentives.verify_flag: Verify developer bank tie-up with Central Nodal Agencies (HUDCO/NHB)

incentives.title: UP Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) 0.5x - 1.0x FAR Bonus
incentives.authority: Uttar Pradesh Housing and Urban Planning Department
incentives.applicable_typology: Mixed-Use & Commercial High-Density within 500m of Metro
incentives.benefits: Purchasable or free FAR enhancement of 0.5x to 1.0x above base FAR, lowering per-sqft land acquisition burden.
incentives.eligibility: Site within 500m of operational or sanctioned metro corridor (e.g. Aqua Line, Blue Line).
incentives.verify_flag: Subject to NOIDA / NMRC TOD notification alignment

incentives.title: State Green Building 5% Additional FAR Incentive
incentives.authority: NOIDA / Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority
incentives.applicable_typology: All Typologies (IGBC / GRIHA 4-Star or Gold/Platinum rated)
incentives.benefits: 5% extra FAR granted without additional compounding charges upon achieving Gold or Platinum green rating.
incentives.eligibility: Mandatory solar rooftop (min 20% load), rainwater harvesting, and tertiary STP recycling.
incentives.verify_flag: Requires provisional pre-certification prior to building plan sanction

incentives.title: UP Data Center Policy 100% Stamp Duty Exemption
incentives.authority: Department of IT & Electronics, Govt. of Uttar Pradesh
incentives.benefits: 100% exemption on stamp duty on first purchase/lease of land; 50% capital subsidy on transmission infrastructure.
incentives.eligibility: Minimum power load capacity of 5MW and minimum capital investment of ₹100 Cr.
incentives.verify_flag: Requires State Empowered Committee (SEC) in-principle approval
